overview: We write the documentation developers read before they decide to use your API. We go through your endpoints, test each one, and write a quick start, plain descriptions, copy-and-paste examples and an error guide. The docs are published as a clean page on your own site or as a file in your repository, and we organise them so a new developer can make a first call in minutes.

faq: Do I need an OpenAPI file already?
No. If you have one we use it. If not, we create one while documenting the endpoints, and you keep it. It can then power the try-it panel and future updates.
Can you document an API someone else built?
Yes. We need access to a test version of the API and any existing notes. We run each call ourselves so the examples are correct, and we flag odd behavior we find.
On your own site, in your repository or on a docs tool you already pay for. We pick a simple option with you and do not lock you in to a service of ours.
Will you keep the docs updated?
This service covers the first complete version and a guide for editing it. Ongoing updates are quoted separately, or your team can keep them current with our notes.
